_about: Synthetic eval dataset for the DEMO scenario (synthetic 'Учебная поездка' regulation). NOT a real eval — sample texts are deliberately simple so that a heuristic extractor can reach 100% on them; a real LLM must do the same on harder, noisier real-world phrases.
